meta.story: Bablu ka Hotel (Hindi) EP5: five kilo paneer bought yesterday is gone today; Ramu the cook admits half spoiled and he threw it without writing it down; Kaka says keep Rizstay's waste log (what, how much, who logged it); Priya says enter purchases and stock refills itself, and reports filter by date and export to Excel; Bablu tracks every gram on his phone

beats.label: BABLU KA HOTEL · EP 5
beats.say: Kal paanch kilo paneer aaya tha... aaj phir khatam? Paneer gaya kahaan?!
beats.headline: Kal 5 kilo paneer aaya. Aaj *khatam*?

beats.label: SEND THIS TO WHOEVER RUNS YOUR KITCHEN
beats.say: Saab, aadha paneer kharab ho gaya tha... maine phenk diya. Kahin likha nahi.

beats.label: 1 · WASTE LOG: WHAT, HOW MUCH
beats.say: Beta, Rizstay ka waste log rakho. Kya phenka,

beats.label: 2 · AND WHO LOGGED IT
beats.say: kitna phenka, aur kisne likha... sab dikhega.

beats.label: 3 · PURCHASES REFILL THE STOCK
beats.say: Sir, naya paneer kharido toh purchase mein daalo,

beats.label: 3 · PURCHASES REFILL THE STOCK
beats.headline: Purchase in. Stock *refills itself*.
beats.say: stock apne aap bhar jaata hai.

beats.label: 4 · REPORTS BY DATE, TO EXCEL
beats.headline: Filter by date. *Export to Excel.*
beats.say: Aur report date se filter karke Excel mein nikaal lo.

beats.label: EP 6 KAL · FOLLOW KARO
beats.say: Ab har gram paneer ka hisaab mere phone pe! Agla episode kal...
